name: Atelier Playa Mujeres
positioning: All-suites Caribbean resort in Playa Mujeres, shaped by contemporary Mexican art and surrounded by a Greg Norman golf course
best_for: Couples who want an art-filled, all-suites Caribbean resort away from the Cancun strip
Golfers who want an 18-hole Greg Norman course on the doorstep
Spa lovers drawn to a spa set in a mangrove jungle

facts.text: The resort sits alongside the Caribbean Sea.
The resort is surrounded by the 18-hole Playa Mujeres golf course.
The suites were conceived by Mexican creatives.
It is an all-suites resort with contemporary designs in an ambiance inspired by Mexican culture.
Every suite has a private balcony, with golf course, tropical or ocean views.
NUUP Spa offers treatments, massages and facials that incorporate millennial practices.
The VITALITY wellness program is built on mindfulness, healthiness and fitness.
A mobile app unlocks suite doors and also serves as a digital concierge.
The Pet-It concept welcomes dogs, with dedicated dog-sitters and a five-course room-service menu for pets.
María Dolores by Edgar Núñez is a fine-dining restaurant that fuses pre-Hispanic cooking traditions with contemporary Mexican culinary practices.

highlights.text: NUUP Spa stands at the heart of Playa Mujeres' mangrove jungle.
The stay is shaped by contemporary Mexican art, with works by contemporary Mexican artists throughout the resort, and by its Handcrafted Hospitality service.
Inspira Suites guests have their own INSPIRA Beach section and a rooftop infinity pool.
The 18-hole course was designed by golf legend Greg Norman and winds through natural landscapes, with encounters with local wildlife.
The resort offers butler service and rooftop amenities such as the El Cielo sky bar.

considerations.text: María Dolores carries an additional charge and is included only for some suite categories.
The resort is set away from the busier strip of Cancun, with a smaller feel and lots of Spanish-speaking clientele.
WhataHotel notes the resort is adults-only, so it does not suit families with children.
